module_microarchitecture.name: csr_block
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact host CSR/register-window decoder with explicit 64-bit valid/ready handshaking.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Decode host writes and reads into semantic control fields for launch, timeout, freshness, flow velocity, geometry length, job/sequence tracking, fault clear, interrupt enable, actuator limits, slew limit, model ID, and geometry format ID. Generate one-cycle launch pulses and deterministic readback values.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Small control/status register state only; no bulk payload storage. Reset clears configuration to safe defaults and deasserts launch.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive host_ready and host_rdata plus the semantic configuration/control outputs consumed by the rest of the wrapper.
ownership_notes: Owns the CSR control contract and host-visible register semantics.
Does not expose payload arrays, worker packets, or actuator outputs.

module_microarchitecture.name: geometry_staging
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Bounded geometry-stream acceptance and staging controller with valid/ready semantics.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Accept 64-bit geometry beats, honor keep/last, count accepted fragments, and terminate on geom_last or configured length. Flag malformed length/keep/termination conditions as capture error.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Bounded capture bookkeeping only; no architectural geometry array is exposed as pins and no unbounded register array is specified.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive ready/backpressure plus capture-done, capture-error, stream-count, and checksum summary metadata for downstream packaging.
ownership_notes: Owns the bounded capture window and summary metadata.
Does not own final actuator outputs, worker requests, or host bus semantics.

module_microarchitecture.name: request_packager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Compact descriptor assembler for a bounded 64-bit outbound request stream.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Combine CSR configuration and geometry summary metadata into a request descriptor containing model ID, geometry format ID, flow condition metadata, stream length, job ID, sequence ID, and checksum/CRC information.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Minimal descriptor emission state only; no model internals or payload arrays.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Emit request_valid/request_data/request_keep/request_last with completion semantics and acceptance indication.
ownership_notes: Owns the outbound request descriptor contents and handshake semantics.
Does not own transport state or actuator outputs.

module_microarchitecture.name: transport_manager
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Single request/response transport sequencer between the controller and external worker.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Forward compact outbound requests, accept bounded inbound responses, track outstanding transaction state, assert backpressure when busy or the staging window is full, and suppress late/older responses when a newer request is active.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Outstanding-active / response-pending bookkeeping with response beat counting and last-seen tracking; no hidden payload interface.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive worker-facing request and response handshake signals plus transport status for validation and safety logic.
ownership_notes: Owns transport handshake and outstanding-transaction bookkeeping.
Does not own semantic actuator values, host register values, or geometry arrays.

module_microarchitecture.name: validation_guard
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Response correlation and integrity guard placed between transport and actuator mapping.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Verify job/sequence correlation, freshness/age threshold, completeness, checksum integrity, and legal state transition before any response can influence outputs. Reject malformed, stale, mis-tagged, incomplete, or checksum-failing responses.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Simple guard bookkeeping derived from response metadata and transport status; no packet interpretation beyond the bounded response contract.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Release only validated_response_* when all checks pass, otherwise withhold propagation and report reject conditions.
ownership_notes: Owns the validation gate that qualifies a worker response for downstream use.
Does not drive actuator outputs directly or modify host-visible register state.

module_microarchitecture.name: actuator_mapping
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Bounded response-to-command translator that extracts only actuator-relevant summary metadata.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Convert a validated response into raw mode, setpoint, enable, and fallback intent. If multiple candidate outputs exist, consume only the selected actuator-relevant summary.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: No complex state; only completion qualification for a validated response transfer.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive raw actuator summary signals and summary-valid qualifier to the safety path; never directly drive final actuator pins.
ownership_notes: Owns the raw actuator summary values and their validity qualifier.
Does not directly drive the final actuator outputs or host-facing control bits.

module_microarchitecture.name: safety_logic
module_microarchitecture.implementation_style: Final safety envelope and actuator command gate.
module_microarchitecture.control_strategy: Clamp the command to min/max limits, optionally apply slew-rate limiting, force safe fallback on timeout/invalid/stale/transport-error/host-abort conditions, and latch faults when configured.
module_microarchitecture.state_strategy: Minimal safety state including fallback_active and fault_latched, with safe-reset behavior. No complex FSM beyond the explicitly required top-level controller behavior.
module_microarchitecture.output_strategy: Drive the final act_mode, act_setpoint, act_enable, and act_fallback outputs only from safe, validated, clamped command values.
ownership_notes: Owns the safe fallback posture and final actuator command enforcement.
Does not own worker packets, host register outputs, or geometry capture control.

fsm_intent.intent: Initialize all state, clear outstanding request tags, force safe fallback, and hold outputs in safe values until reset is released.
Wait for a valid host launch/configuration and start a new transaction only when the controller is not busy and configuration is valid.
Accept bounded geometry words with keep/last semantics until geom_last or configured length count terminates capture.
Transmit the compact request descriptor to the external worker and hand off to response wait.
Count cycles against the programmable timeout and wait for a worker response; timeout transitions to fallback.
Check response correlation, freshness, completeness, checksum, and legal transition before allowing actuator use.
Update actuator output only after clamp and optional slew limiting succeed.
Drive the safe fallback actuator posture until cleared or until a fresh valid transaction completes, per fault mode.
Latch a fault condition until host clear when latched-fault mode is enabled.

datapath_intent.storage: Small CSR fields only; no bulk geometry or response storage is described as registers.
Bounded implementation-defined staging window only; bulk payload storage is not exposed as top-level registers or pins.
Outstanding transaction bookkeeping and response beat tracking.
Guard bookkeeping and validated response qualifiers only.
Minimal safety state for fallback and fault latching.

sequencing_notes: Host writes and reads complete only under valid/ready handshake semantics.
Geometry capture starts after a legal launch and terminates on geom_last or the configured geometry length, whichever comes first.
Request issue occurs only after geometry capture completes and the controller is not busy or fault-latched.
Worker responses are accepted only for the active outstanding transaction; older or late responses are ignored.
Validated responses must complete before actuator mapping and safety logic may update final outputs.

If any CRC mismatch, tag mismatch, timeout, invalid length, malformed packet, stale response, or transport error occurs, the controller enters fallback and may enter ERROR when latched-fault mode is enabled.
A host clear operation is required to exit ERROR when fault latching is enabled.
timing_notes: All synchronous logic shares the top-level clk and reset_n.
Timeout supervision is cycle-based using a programmable threshold from CSR.
Freshness supervision is cycle-based using a programmable threshold from CSR.
Handshake completion is required for every packet beat; partial packets are never interpreted as commands.
Actuator updates occur only after validation and safety checks have completed on a legal response.
consistency_notes: No hierarchy, ports, or filenames may differ from digital_spec_json.
